name: Multi-Tenant SaaS Conversion
objective: Convert single-user aiPortfolio Next.js site into multi-tenant ad-supported SaaS for jobseekers with tenant isolation, RLS, Auth.js, DO Spaces, and Docker deployment
exit_criteria: PostgreSQL 16 running in Docker with Drizzle schema migrated
Auth.js v5 with database sessions and tenant_id embedded
RLS FORCE policies active on all tenant-scoped tables
DO Spaces file upload with presigned URLs operational
Multi-tenant analysis pipeline with DB-backed cache
GDPR cookie consent and AdSense placement (max 2 ads/page)
Docker Compose deployment with blue-green zero-downtime
Security audit passed — 404 vs 403 isolation verified
